title: Of Light and Heat Obstructa
description: Of Light and Heat Obstructa — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Taxman Jones

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill 10 Ice Mutant Twins and 10 Shadow Fade Hatchlings on Frump's Misfortune Levels 6 and 7.

Quest Reward: 7500 Gold and 1 Kings Coin

Return to: Taxman Jones

Repeatable: No

Tip: An easy quest, just work your way through the levels and the monsters will fall to you.

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Kill 17 Ice Mutant Hulks and 19 Shadow Fade Generals in Lower Frump's Misfortune and Return to Taxman Jones in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

Offer:

I need to keep the pressure on The Frump so he knows I'm not just going to go away. The best way to get to him is to upset his customers, and that is exactly what I plan on doing. Frump's Misfortune has been getting great reviews for its cool and well lit dungeons. I figure that is a good place to start throwing giant crescent wrench shaped maces into the works.

Frump's Misfortune uses Ice Mutants to keep the dungeon cool and Shadow Fade to keep the interiors from being to bright. I want you to take enough of them out so The Frump has no choice but to listen to my demands or face a revolt by his customers. Run down into the main areas of Lower Frump's Misfortune and kill Ice Mutant Hulks and Shadow Fade Generals. When you have killed enough of them return to me, Taxman Jones, here in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

Turn-in:

I bet things are really heating up for The Frump now, eh! Perhaps he is finally starting to see the light? Get it! Right, I'll stick to finances and let the jesters do the jesting.

Objectives:

  • Slain Ice Mutant Hulks
  • Slain Shadow Fade Generals

Level range: 30–45
